model: single pre-specified logistic regression, fixed descriptor set

LEAVE_ONE_POLICY_FAMILY_OUT.note: Row filter excluding one mechanism family at a time; no resimulation.

LEAVE_ONE_SOURCE_OUT.note: Row filter excluding one of the 3 frozen sources; no resimulation.

LOAD_CALIBRATION_SENSITIVITY.note: Row filter to the 4-region subset of the already-executed 6-region grid; no resimulation.

METRIC_DEFINITION_SENSITIVITY.note: Compares the frozen per-policy exclusion rule (docs/RANKING_PORTABILITY_METRIC_DEFINITIONS.md) against a same-family 'drop the whole condition' alternative, computed purely from the existing consolidated metric columns; no resimulation.

PRIMARY_ONLY.note: Row filter over the existing 13-policy panel's 11 PRIMARY members; no resimulation.

SLO_DEFINITION_SENSITIVITY.note: The alternative SLO-synthesis rule (docs/DATA_FIELD_PROVENANCE.md item 3, docs/EXPERIMENT_CAMPAIGN_PLAN.md Stage 5) changes request-level SLO labels at synthesis time, which the frozen campaign's existing cell columns cannot reconstruct after the fact -- flagged as NEW_EXECUTION_REQUIRED_FOR_THIS_SENSITIVITY = YES, not implemented as a row filter or metric recomputation.

TEMPORAL_SPLIT_SENSITIVITY.note: Bisect vs. tercile split of the same already-executed BurstGPT windows (temporal_analysis.py); no resimulation.

WINDOW_SIZE_SENSITIVITY.note: = the sample-complexity subsampling ladder (sample_complexity.py); row selection over already-executed windows, no resimulation.
